// @vitest-environment jsdom
// Drives an OLDER build's real app (this file is copied into that build's tests/ folder, as
// blitzBestDrive.dom.test.jsx) over Blitz Best records as Round 26 saves them — each field with its
// COMPANION, the holder round's other number (engine/blitzBest) — and writes down what the older
// build left of them (run with OLDER_BUILD=<tag> BLITZ_OUT=<file>). The record is
// tests/fixtures/olderBuilds/blitzBest-<build>.json; tests/blitzBest.olderBuilds.test.js holds this
// build to it.
//
// The older builds know a Blitz record as four fields — score, streak, and the id of the round that
// set each — and every write they make builds a fresh record of exactly those four. What is at
// stake is whether a companion they leave behind can be WRONG (a number that is not the holder
// round's) rather than merely missing.
import { describe, it, afterEach } from 'vitest'
import { render, screen, cleanup, fireEvent, act } from '@testing-library/react'
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { App } from '../src/main.jsx'
import { usePresets } from '../src/store/presets.js'
import { useSettings, SETTINGS_DEFAULTS } from '../src/store/settings.js'
import { useModePrefs } from '../src/store/modePrefs.js'
import { useProgress } from '../src/store/progress.js'
import { useUserDefaults } from '../src/store/userDefaults.js'
import { wday } from '../src/lib/calendar.js'
import { DAY } from '../src/lib/format.js'
import { statValue } from './helpers/modeScreen.jsx'

const BUILD = process.env.OLDER_BUILD
// Settings the questions can be read and answered under (numeric-ymd, Gregorian only).
const READABLE = {
  ...SETTINGS_DEFAULTS,
  randomFormat: false,
  dateFormat: 'numeric-ymd',
  minY: 1583,
  maxY: 10000,
}
const PROGRESS = 'cg-progress-v1'
const SETTINGS = 'cg-settings-v1'
const ROUNDS = 'cg-round-v2'
const PARK_SLOT = '1:saved:blitz'
// The Per Round, Allow Mistakes record key these settings file a round under — the older build's
// own formula (modes/BlitzMode's blitzBk), from its own defaults.
const S = READABLE
const KEY = `m60|numeric-ymd|${S.leapChance}|${S.janFebChance}|${S.julianChance}|1583-10000|${S.useJulian}`

function mountApp() {
  const root = document.createElement('div')
  root.id = 'root'
  document.body.appendChild(root)
  return render(<App />)
}
function unmountApp() {
  cleanup()
  document.getElementById('root')?.remove()
}
const isHidden = (el) => {
  for (let n = el; n; n = n.parentElement) if (n.style && n.style.display === 'none') return true
  return false
}
// The live question on the screen that is SHOWING (every mode's screen stays mounted, each with a
// date of its own).
function readDate() {
  const els = [...document.querySelectorAll('div')].filter(
    (e) => e.children.length === 0 && /^-?\d+-\d+-\d+$/.test(e.textContent.trim()) && !isHidden(e),
  )
  if (els.length !== 1) throw new Error(`expected one visible date, found ${els.length}`)
  const [y, m, d] = els[0].textContent.trim().split('-').map(Number)
  return { y, m, d }
}
const correctDayName = ({ y, m, d }) => DAY[wday(y, m, d)]
const visibleButton = (name) => screen.getAllByRole('button', { name }).find((b) => !isHidden(b))
const has = (name) => screen.queryAllByRole('button', { name }).some((b) => !isHidden(b))
const tap = (el) =>
  act(() => {
    fireEvent.pointerDown(el)
    fireEvent.click(el, { detail: 1 })
  })
const right = () => tap(visibleButton(correctDayName(readDate())))
const wrong = () => {
  const { y, m, d } = readDate()
  tap(visibleButton(DAY[(wday(y, m, d) + 1) % 7]))
}
const press = (name) => tap(visibleButton(name))
const toBlitz = () => act(() => void fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: 'B' }))
// A page load of the older build: every store reads storage again, then the app mounts.
function load() {
  act(() => {
    usePresets.persist.rehydrate()
    useSettings.persist.rehydrate()
    useModePrefs.persist.rehydrate()
    useProgress.persist.rehydrate()
    useUserDefaults.persist.rehydrate()
  })
  mountApp()
}
const put = (key, state, version) => localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify({ state, version }))
const stored = (key, area = localStorage) => JSON.parse(area.getItem(key) ?? 'null')
const record = () => stored(PROGRESS)?.state?.blitzBest?.[KEY] ?? null
const blank = () => ({ played: 0, good: 0, streak: 0, best: 0, times: [] })
// A device this build has been used on: readable settings, and one Blitz record in this build's shape.
function seedDevice(rec) {
  localStorage.clear()
  sessionStorage.clear()
  put(SETTINGS, READABLE, 4)
  put(
    PROGRESS,
    {
      stats: {
        classic: blank(),
        flash: blank(),
        dedDay: blank(),
        dedMonth: blank(),
        dedYear: blank(),
      },
      blitzBest: { [KEY]: rec },
      suddenBest: {},
      suddenAmBest: {},
      aoxBest: {},
    },
    5,
  )
}
// Best Score 5 (round 111, whose best streak was 3), Best Streak 4 (round 222, whose score was 2).
const R26 = {
  score: 5,
  scoreStreak: 3,
  scoreRoundId: 111,
  streak: 4,
  streakScore: 2,
  streakRoundId: 222,
}

const out = { key: KEY }
afterEach(unmountApp)

describe(`blitzBest drive — ${BUILD}`, () => {
  it('(i) a Classic answer: the record is saved back as it was found', () => {
    seedDevice(R26)
    load()
    press('New')
    right()
    out.classicAnswer = { played: stored(PROGRESS).state.stats.classic.played, record: record() }
  })

  it('(i) a Blitz round that beats neither field', () => {
    seedDevice(R26)
    load()
    toBlitz()
    press('Begin')
    right()
    press('Reveal') // ends 1/2
    out.roundBelow = { score: statValue('Score'), record: record() }
  })

  it('(ii) a round that takes the Best Score only — (iii) and an Override that hands it back', () => {
    seedDevice(R26)
    load()
    toBlitz()
    press('Begin')
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) right()
    wrong() // Allow Mistakes on: the streak breaks, the date stays
    right() // the burned date: answered, no credit
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) right()
    press('Reveal') // 6 right, a streak of 3 at most
    out.takesScore = { score: statValue('Score'), record: record() }
    press('<') // the last credited card
    press('Override') // its credit taken back: 5, a tie — the field goes back to round 111
    out.handsBack = { score: statValue('Score'), record: record() }
  })

  // (iv) A ROUND THIS BUILD PARKED, restored by the older build in the same tab (a tab that moves
  // between the test site and the live one keeps its session). The older build plays and parks the
  // round itself; the park and the record are then given exactly what this build would have saved
  // for that round — the companions — and the app is reloaded over them. Then an Override on a card
  // BEHIND the live one moves the holder round's score while every one of the four older fields
  // stands still.
  //   • `asParkedUnstamped`: the round's configuration as the older build computes it — what this
  //     build would park had it not stamped the configuration.
  //   • `asParkedStamped`: the configuration as Round 26 parks it ('companions|' in front).
  for (const stamped of [false, true])
    it(`(iv) a round this build parked${stamped ? ', stamped' : ', unstamped'}, restored and Overridden`, () => {
      // Best Score 12 (round 111, streak 3), Best Streak 2 (round 222, score 9).
      seedDevice({ ...R26, score: 12, scoreStreak: 3, streak: 2, streakScore: 9 })
      load()
      toBlitz()
      press('Begin')
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) right() // a streak of 4: Best Streak, this round's
      wrong() // card 5 burned
      right() // …answered, no credit
      wrong() // card 6 burned
      right() // …answered, no credit
      right() // card 7: credited, a streak of 1
      press('Reveal') // card 8: the round ends on 5 right, a streak of 4
      const roundRecord = record()
      const park = stored(ROUNDS, sessionStorage)
      const round = park[PARK_SLOT]
      // What this build would have saved: the record with its companions, and the same in the park.
      const progress = stored(PROGRESS)
      progress.state.blitzBest[KEY] = {
        ...roundRecord,
        scoreStreak: 3,
        streakScore: 5, // the round's score as it ended
      }
      localStorage.setItem(PROGRESS, JSON.stringify(progress))
      round.prevRoundBest.blitz = { ...round.prevRoundBest.blitz, scoreStreak: 3, streakScore: 9 }
      if (stamped) round.config = `companions|${round.config}`
      sessionStorage.setItem(ROUNDS, JSON.stringify(park))
      unmountApp()
      load()
      toBlitz()
      const restored = has('Reset')
      const before = { restored, record: record() }
      if (restored) {
        press('<') // card 7
        press('<') // card 6, burned
        press('Override') // credited: the score 5 → 6, the streak still 4 at most
      }
      out[stamped ? 'asParkedStamped' : 'asParkedUnstamped'] = {
        before,
        begin: has('Begin'),
        score: restored ? statValue('Score') : null,
        record: record(),
        parkLeft: stored(ROUNDS, sessionStorage)?.[PARK_SLOT] != null,
      }
    })

  it('writes the record', () => {
    writeFileSync(process.env.BLITZ_OUT, JSON.stringify(out, null, 2) + '\n')
  })
})
